data.long_meaning: Mutarrif is an Arabic name that means one who is discerning, wise, and has good judgment. The name Mutarrif carries the meaning “One who is discerning” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mutarrif usually hope their child will grow to embody one who is discerning and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A hadith states: 'The discerning one is not the one who is wise in his own eyes, but the one who is wise in the eyes of Allah.'
data.etymology: Mutarrif belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who is discerning.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mutarrif total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_urdu.name: مطرّف
